    is_prem = seg == "Premium"
    flags = pd.Series(False, index=cleaned.index)
    for col in ["balance","avg_balance_90d","avg_txn_amount"]:

        cleaned.loc[mask, col] = fb
        flags |= mask
    cleaned["flag_completitud_premium"] = flags
    return cleaned
# Premium: campos numéricos obligatorios

    cleaned = df.copy()
    for col in ["last_txn_date","account_open_date"]:
        col_str = cleaned[col].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
        slash = col_str.str.fullmatch(r"\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}")

            conv = pd.to_datetime(col_str[slash], format="%d/%m/%Y", errors="coerce")
            cleaned.loc[slash, col] = conv.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        cleaned[f"flag_validez_{col}_fmt"] = slash
    return cleaned
# DD/MM/YYYY → YYYY-MM-DD
